props.name: content
props.description: Renders the content of the legend. This should return HTML elements, not SVG elements. - If not set, the {@link DefaultLegendContent } component is used. - If set to a React element, this element will be cloned and extra props will be passed in. - If set to a function, the function will be called and should return HTML elements.

props.name: formatter
props.description: Function to customize how content is serialized before rendering. This should return HTML elements, or strings.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the legend. Accept CSS style string values like `100%` or `fit-content`, or number values like `400`.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: The size of icon in each legend item.

props.name: iconType
props.description: The type of icon in each legend item.

props.name: inactiveColor
props.description: The color of the icon when the item is inactive.

props.name: itemSorter
props.description: Sorts Legend items. Defaults to `value` which means it will sort alphabetically by the label. If `null` is provided then the payload is not sorted. Be aware that without sort, the order of items may change between renders!

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: Style of individual items inside the Legend, a `<span>` element. These show the data label (name, or dataKey) and value. If a chart has multiple graphical items then the Legend renders multiple item and each of them gets this itemStyle applied. Pie charts render multiple labels from a single data series. Note that this is different from {@link Tooltip }: - in Tooltip: "labelStyle" styles the title / header - in Tooltip: "itemStyle" styles the individual data points - in Legend: "labelStyle" styles the individual data points Beware of the naming inconsistency!

props.name: layout
props.description: The layout of legend items inside the legend container. When `auto` then the layout is decided based on the `position` prop: - in `left`|`right` positions, the layout is vertical - otherwise horizontal - if position is undefined, also horizontal `auto` value is new since 3.10

props.name: offset
props.description: The offset to the specified `position`. Direction of the offset depends on the position.

props.name: onClick
props.type: (data: LegendPayload, index: number, event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void
props.description: The customized event handler of click on the items in this group

props.name: onMouseEnter
props.type: (data: LegendPayload, index: number, event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void
props.description: The customized event handler of mouseenter on the items in this group

props.name: onMouseLeave
props.type: (data: LegendPayload, index: number, event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void
props.description: The customized event handler of mouseleave on the items in this group

props.name: portal
props.description: If portal is defined, then Legend will use this element as a target for rendering using React Portal. If this is undefined then Legend renders inside the recharts-wrapper element.

props.name: position
props.description: The position of the legend relative to the chart. If this is defined, it overrides `align` and `verticalAlign`.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the legend. Accept CSS style string values like `100%` or `fit-content`, or number values like `400`.

props.name: wrapperStyle
props.description: CSS styles to be applied to the wrapper `div` element.

props.name: payload
props.type: { value?: string; color?: string; dataKey?: string | number; }[]

props.name: active
props.description: If true, then Tooltip is always displayed, once an activeIndex is set by mouse over, or programmatically. If false, then Tooltip is never displayed. If undefined, Recharts will control when the Tooltip displays. This includes mouse and keyboard controls.

props.name: allowEscapeViewBox
props.description: This option allows the tooltip to extend beyond the viewBox of the chart itself.

props.name: animationDuration
props.description: Specifies the duration of animation, the unit of this option is ms.

props.name: animationEasing
props.description: The type of easing function.

props.name: axisId
props.description: Tooltip always attaches itself to the "Tooltip" axis. Which axis is it? Depends on the layout: - horizontal layout -> X axis - vertical layout -> Y axis - radial layout -> radial axis - centric layout -> angle axis Tooltip will use the default axis for the layout, unless you specify an axisId.

props.name: content
props.description: Renders the content of the tooltip. This should return HTML elements, not SVG elements. - If not set, the {@link DefaultTooltipContent } component is used. - If set to a React element, this element will be cloned and extra props will be passed in. - If set to a function, the function will be called and should return HTML elements.

props.name: contentStyle
props.description: CSS styles to be applied to the wrapper `div` element.

props.name: cursor
props.description: If set false, no cursor will be drawn when tooltip is active. If set a object, the option is the configuration of cursor. If set a React element, the option is the custom react element of drawing cursor.

props.name: filterNull
props.description: When an item of the payload has value null or undefined, this item won't be displayed.

props.name: formatter
props.type: Formatter<ValueType, NameType> & ((value: ValueType, name: NameType, item: TooltipPayload…
props.typeFull: Formatter<ValueType, NameType> & ((value: ValueType, name: NameType, item: TooltipPayloadEntry, index: number, payload: TooltipPayload) => ReactNode | [ReactNode, ReactNode])
props.description: Function to customize the value in the tooltip. If you return an array, the first entry will be the formatted "value", and the second entry will be the formatted "name"

props.name: includeHidden
props.description: If true, the tooltip will display information about hidden series. Defaults to false. Interacting with the hide property of Area, Bar, Line, Scatter.

props.name: isAnimationActive
props.description: If set false, animation of tooltip will be disabled. If set "auto", the animation will be disabled in SSR and will respect the user's prefers-reduced-motion system preference for accessibility.

props.name: itemSorter
props.description: Sorts tooltip items. Defaults to 'name' which means it sorts alphabetically by graphical item `name` property.

props.name: itemStyle
props.description: Style of individual items inside the tooltip, a `<li>` element. These show the data label (name, or dataKey) and value. If a chart has multiple graphical items then the Tooltip renders multiple item and each of them gets this itemStyle applied.

props.name: labelFormatter
props.type: ((label: ReactNode, payload: readonly Payload<ValueType, NameType>[]) => ReactNode) & ((l…
props.typeFull: ((label: ReactNode, payload: readonly Payload<ValueType, NameType>[]) => ReactNode) & ((label: ReactNode, payload: TooltipPayload) => ReactNode)
props.description: The formatter function of label in tooltip.

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: "Label" is the tooltip title. Renders once on the top of tooltip and shows categorical axis value. Even if there are multiple graphical items in the chart, only one label gets rendered. Note that "Label" in tooltip is the header, which is different from {@link Legend } where "labelStyle" are the individual items.

props.name: offset
props.description: The offset size between the position of tooltip and the mouse cursor position. When a number is provided, the same offset is applied to both x and y axes. When a Coordinate object is provided, you can specify different offsets for each axis (x and y as numbers)

props.name: portal
props.description: If portal is defined, then Tooltip will use this element as a target for rendering using React Portal: https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/createPortal If this is undefined then Tooltip renders inside the recharts-wrapper element.

props.name: position
props.description: If this field is set, the tooltip will be displayed at the specified position regardless of the mouse position. You can set a single field (x or y) and let the other field be calculated automatically based on the mouse position.

props.name: separator
props.description: The separator between name and value.

props.name: shared
props.description: Defines whether the tooltip is reacting to the current data point, or to all data points at the current axis coordinate. - `true`: tooltip will appear on top of all bars on an axis tick. - `false`: tooltip will appear on individual bars. Different chart types allow different modes, and have different defaults.

props.name: trigger
props.description: If `hover` then the Tooltip shows on mouse enter and hides on mouse leave. If `click` then the Tooltip shows after clicking and stays active.

props.name: wrapperStyle
props.description: CSS styles to be applied to the wrapper `div` element.
